review.notes: Independent review after FIX-PKG-BorelRegulators~adv2 (Claude, session claude-IjmpHx). One defect cannot be fixed by a reviewer and needs a maintainer decision: README §6.2 gets tau(G_m)=1 by converting the volume kappa of the norm-one idele class group, which it says AutomorphicLFunctionsAndLocalFactors AL.1 supplies. The current AL roadmap (TauCetiRoadmap PR #924, head d1996dc) no longer has kappa. The Tate's-thesis rule of PACKAGE_REVIEW.md (2026-10-19) forbids any package from stating the norm-one idele-class volume. No AdelicAlgebraicGroups (PR #792, head 58ecae2), GlobalNumberFields or Tau Ceti library item supplies tau(G_m)=1. Yet the step tau(H)=tau(GL_1(D))/tau(G_m) cannot be avoided, and it lies on the proof path of §§6.3, 7.1 and 7.2. Fixed in place: (1) 18 theorem names were used but never introduced; each is now named at its own subsection, using the plan's declaration names, and cross-references that pointed nowhere now point to named API items. (2) Supplier corrections. The reduced norm is ClassicalArithmeticCompletion §7.10, and SL_n(D) its §7.26. The quaternion Hasse–Schilling–Maass case is AdelicAlgebraicGroups §4.6, not GN.2. The overlap with GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic §3.3 is now noted. Adelic Poisson summation is AL.0 for 𝔸^n, with its scalar case in ArithmeticGaloisRepresentations §2.7. (3) Wrong locators. Burgos has no §§5.6–5.7 and no Theorem 6.18: van Est is Proposition 6.8 and Theorem 6.9, pp.53–54, and the compact twin is §6.3 with Example 6.10, pp.54–55. Burgos Lemma 10.2 is on p.90. (4) The §2.4 exchange-sign claim was false and is corrected to Nrd=(−1)^{mm′e}. (5) The README was 209,028 bytes, over the issue's 200 KB limit; it is now 196,110. Repeated full-title links became author-year citations, with the full links in References and every locator kept. Trailing paragraphs that only repeated a subsection's Checks were dropped, and an uncited reference was removed. (6) Suggested.lean: traceCocycle_three is now proved (axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), so the two trace examples no longer rest on a sorry. Checks run: about 45 locators read in the sources (Borel 1974/1977, Burgos, Weibel IV/VI, Goncharov, Mars, Godement, Putman–Studenmund, Platonov–Rapinchuk–Rapinchuk); all others resolve. In §8.5 the relative/absolute cohomology claim was recomputed exactly, as were the Pauli frame, the ideal-simplex orientation and Weibel's [x]=(0,∞,1,x) labelling; the magnitude 1/π is confirmed.
